title: 2_7_The_Halloween_Dance_Part_1

question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Which couple do you like best?
Who do you want to see more of?

nodes.text: Ben picks up his pace, following everyone as they run through the house.
Up ahead, he can see the front door hanging open.
He sprints for it...
And rushes outside into the open air!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Whew!
The boys head back to the cars. Ben comes up to Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ha ha. You ran pretty fast back there. I had a hard time keeping up! Did you really think we were being chased by a gargoyle?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No way. It's just some lame story you made up. It was probably the wind.
But Spencer still hurries to the car, and he's the first one out of the parking lot.
Suddenly, a light flashes, and Sam sees the Grim Reaper swooping down on her!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Whoa!
Sam ducks out of the way!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: He almost hit me!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thank goodness you escaped death?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's a little predictable if you ask me... What else is there?
Sam and $ZOE walk out into the cemetery at the back.
The black light illuminates the jars.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This is cool, but it's kind of hard to see in here...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, it is...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Shall we move on?
The ominous clinking of chains echoes throughout the room.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: The setup is great, but the sound effects are a little weird. It sounds more like construction.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh well... No time to fix it today. I'll try to remember tomorrow.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ben, thank you for your help! I hope that everyone will enjoy it...
At that moment, Sam wanders into the gym.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE, I got off practice early, so I came by to see if you need any help.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We're just about done. Come take a look!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wow, your haunted house is really coming together!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Want a tour? I have a few minutes before I head out for Howard's family dinner.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Heck yeah!
$ZOE shows Sam into a dark dining room.
Skeletons sit in chairs at a long table while candles inside Jack o'lanterns and skulls sit on black candlestick holders, eerily turning on and off.
Cobwebs cover everything in a fine, silky blanket.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Over the Grim Reaper costume?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Clowns are the scariest monsters of all...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Here's a scary clown mask, some bright clothes, a red nose...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That'll scare people!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It feels the most traditional.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay, here's a scary skull mask, some dark robes, and a scythe...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That'll freak people out!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Anything else?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: One last thing... I definitely liked how you had a surprise at the end.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Let me guess, the broom isn't doing it for you?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I was thinking we could transform the broom into something. That way, when it falls on people, it'll really be freaky.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I have a clown costume we can put on it... Or I also have this traditional Grim Reaper outfit...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay. I'd go with the...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Black lights will look cool.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Strobe lights will make it look like a thriller movie for sure!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Next up is lighting... The mad scientist's room is great, but...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Special lighting would make it really creepy. I have a black light and a strobe light. Which one do you want?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ghostly wailing, it is!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Clinking chains, it is!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How do I do that?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, instead of having one dark room, we should set up a bunch of rooms with different scary themes!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can totally see us making a mad scientist's laboratory with all these beakers you brought over.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And the cardboard grave stones you brought would make an amazing cemetery!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah! Those are great ideas! I have some gross spider and insect candies... We could create a creepy haunted feast!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Good idea! Let's set it up!
And so, $ZOE and Ben put together three different rooms for her haunted house.
Some time and a lot of work later...
$ZOE stands in front of her newly constructed haunted house.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: This looks good. Just a few last details... First, you have to set the mood.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I have some Halloween sound effects on my laptop: 'Ghostly Wailing' or 'Clinking Chains'.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You should probably choose only one, or else it will be confusing to people going through.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I want...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Halloween movies are always set at night. So, it must be the darkness.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: True, but there's a lot more that goes into a 'haunted' house than just being dark.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What's really scary about a haunted house is the unknown, the element of surprise. We have to introduce that into your house.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The scariest parts of thrillers are always the times when you don't know where the monster is.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Exactly!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The best surprise is the scary surprise.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So to have the best haunted house, you need something that's going to surprise everyone inside.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, Taylor...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You shouldn't thank me yet... You still have a lot to do.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So what's going on with the Halloween Dance? Are we meeting to talk about it?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: We already met.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You met without me?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I told you what would happen if you missed another meeting last week! That's your `third` strike, $ZOE.
nodes.text_bbcode: I told you what would happen if you missed another meeting last week! That's your [color=#3b78e2][i]third[/i][/color] strike, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Taylor... Please don't kick me out of the race. I promise you I'll do my job this time.
For a moment, Taylor is genuinely conflicted... Then she sighs.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Fine. You get `one more strike.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Fine. You get [color=#3b78e2][i]one more strike.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Baseball does that sometimes, right?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh, not `really...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, not [color=#e23b3b][i]really...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: $ZOE gives him a look, and Howard quiets down.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But this is your last chance, $ZOE. If you blow it, Paige wins.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Anyway, here's the gist. Each of you will get one half of the gym space to plan and host an event. This will be your chance to prove to the students of Twin Branches that you're the right girl for Social Chair.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Do it right, and you'll get all the votes you need.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's my event?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Since you weren't there, it was only fair to let Paige determine the two events. She's going to be running a Halloween carnival...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Another carnival? I did that for the fundraiser.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: She chose the carnival so she could 'crush everyone's memory of that puny fundraiser carnival into the ground'... Her words, not mine.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh... What am I doing?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You are running the haunted house!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: To be honest, I think she let you off easy.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, except that I don't know how to do `haunted!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, except that I don't know how to do [color=#3b78e2][i]haunted![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, if you want to get votes, you'd better figure out how.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: The gym will be open tomorrow afternoon for you to set everything up.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How much money do I have to work with?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Let's see...
Taylor takes out her phone and checks her notes.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, according to Paige's budget, the haunted house gets...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ten dollars.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's it?! I can't construct an entire haunted house with ten dollars!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Where's the rest of the money?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Paige put the majority of it into food and music. Decorations are mainly on you and her to bring in.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's okay... I'll be by your side.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Actually, Howard... You can't come to the dance. Non-students aren't allowed on the campus.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Are you serious? But I used to go to Twin Branches.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hey, I'm doing you a favor... Unless you want to be forcefully escorted off-grounds by Officer Monte.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No, thanks.
$ZOE takes Howard's hand.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's okay... You'll be there in spirit.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah...
The next afternoon...
$ZOE and Ben walk into the gym carrying boxes of Halloween decorations.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You have no idea how glad I am that you came. I know I called you at the last minute, but you're the only one I can think of who would have the right stuff.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, I wasn't using these Halloween decorations anyway.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thank you. Really. Honestly, I don't know what I would have done without you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't have the money to spend on Halloween decorations. And Sam couldn't help me decorate because she has swim practice today.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Plus, I don't have that much time to set everything up since I have a dinner with Howard's family tonight...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Whoa, slow down there... I get it. I'm awesome! Don't worry, my services are only `one million dollars` an hour...
nodes.text_bbcode: Whoa, slow down there... I get it. I'm awesome! Don't worry, my services are only [color=#e23b3b][i]one million dollars[/i][/color] an hour...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee. Expensive, but worth it.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So where do these boxes need to go?
$ZOE points out her side of the gym.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Over there. I've set up some of the haunted house already. Want to go through it? I'd love to know what you think.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm always up for a haunted house.
Ben puts down his boxes as $ZOE walks him into her 'house'.
$ZOE leads Ben into a very messy bedroom.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Here it is!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's, uh...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Frilly.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, before you got here, these were the only decorations I really had.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But look how `messy` it is! What kind of `scary` girl doesn't clean her own room?
nodes.text_bbcode: But look how [color=#3b78e2][i]messy[/i][/color] it is! What kind of [color=#3b78e2][i]scary[/i][/color] girl doesn't clean her own room?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ha ha, okay...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But that's not all...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: There's more? Is something going to leap out from under the bed? Is there a guy in a hockey mask hiding in the closet with a knife?
At the word 'closet', Ben sees $ZOE's face light up.
He walks to the closet and throws open the door! There's a 'whoosh' in the air, and Ben jumps back, just in time to avoid a broom which clatters at his feet!
Ben starts laughing as he exits the house.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: A broom? You got a broom to fall on me?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is it not scary enough?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ha ha... No. But it's awfully funny.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I told you I couldn't do 'scary'! My haunted house is going to be a disaster!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And I only have a couple hours to fix it!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Relax! It'll be fine. I can help you out.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Now what makes a haunted house scary?

nodes.prompt: What makes a haunted house scary?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What makes a haunted house scary?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That's the lamest excuse I've ever heard!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What's to stop you from forgetting to put Homecoming on your calendar?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Or Prom?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Or Christmas!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Christmas is already on the calendar... Like, every calendar...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Luckily for `you!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Luckily for [color=#3b78e2][i]you![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Look, we're kind of friends.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So I'm letting you have this chance. Don't screw it up because next time you're on your own!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You're right. That's not an excuse.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But I guess I get it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You... You do?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah. My boyfriend was in a long-distance relationship...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Right... Brendan and Dinah.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ugh, don't remind me.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What I'm saying is... He wasn't able to handle it, and it's a tough spot.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So I kind of know what you're going through.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thank you.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But you need to stop screwing up! You're not getting a handout next time.
You are now playing as $ZOE.
At a local cafe after school, Howard and $ZOE talk about their relationship.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So what about Kingston?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What about it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If we're going to make this work, how are we going to deal with you going back to college?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I've been thinking about that, and there are two ways to go about it.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Either we do long distance... Or I move back here.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Move back here?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What do you think of that?
$ZOE remembers all the work Howard put into applying to Kingston in the first place and feels her heart sink.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, I--

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: `$ZOE!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]$ZOE![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Taylor interrupts $ZOE as she storms up to their table!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Taylor? What are you...
$ZOE trails off as a sudden and very important reminder flashes in her mind.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no! The meeting!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What meeting?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Paige, Taylor, and I were going to meet to talk about the Halloween Dance two days from now.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I totally forgot! Taylor, I'm so--

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Save it. After what you pulled today, I don't even think I should give you a chance!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's like you don't even care about the position! What happened?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, so this isn't really an excuse, but...

options.label: I forgot to put it on my calendar.

nodes.text: Ben tries to sprint for the doorway, but he freezes in fear!
As the guys rush past him, he gets shoulder checked and falls to the ground.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ahh!
Ben hits his head on the hard wood. His vision blurs and dims.
The last thing he sees before falling unconscious is the face of a devil in the darkness...
Ben has failed.
Try again and see if you can help Ben get out of the house in time!
You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

format.pattern: You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It used its evil magic to take over the souls of the sculptor and his family.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: None of them were ever seen again...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What happened to the gargoyle?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: The gargoyle lives on... It sits in the backyard of the house, waiting for Devil's Night to come around again...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So it can find its next victim...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And `strike!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And [color=#e23b3b][i]strike![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `BOO!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]BOO![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Spencer jumps out from behind a couch, and all the girls shriek and start running towards the cabin's door.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ahhhhhh!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: It's the gargoyle! It's real!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Ahhh! It's in the house! And it looks ugly!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Ahhh! I'm getting out of here!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I don't want my soul to be cursed!
Ben, Spencer, and the rest of the boys laugh as the girls run out into the woods towards their cars.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Great prank, Spencer!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah! Emily's never going to live this one down.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Did you `see` the look on Jill's face? Priceless!
nodes.text_bbcode: Did you [color=#e23b3b][i]see[/i][/color] the look on Jill's face? Priceless!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I can't believe those wimps! There's nothing to be scared of--
Suddenly, a strong wind blows through the cabin. The flames in the fireplace burst out then die, and the doors upstairs start slamming!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ahh!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It's the gargoyle!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Run!
Everyone flees from the cabin!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Did you know that the night before Halloween is called `Devil's Night?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Did you know that the night before Halloween is called [color=#e23b3b][i]Devil's Night?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's the night when evil spirits and ghosts are able to come to our world and walk among us.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And on that night so many years ago, an evil spirit possessed the gargoyle!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Spooky!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: The evil spirit seeped into the stone, making the gargoyle blink its horrible red eyes and come to life!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: The cursed sculptor created a cursed gargoyle.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But how did he become cursed?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Was he born that way?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Was it because of his parents? Did they upset a witch?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, a witch cursed his parents, and he was born cursed!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And with his cursed powers, he was possessed by a dark demon who made him fascinated with dark things!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Which is what ultimately pushed him to create this gargoyle!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh, sure...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wow, that got out of hand...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Anyway, as I was saying...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: The gargoyle came to life!
You are now playing as $ZOE.
It's the night of the Halloween Dance.
$ZOE, Sam, and Spencer stand in front of the haunted house with a sense of pride.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The gargoyle is a great touch! You guys didn't have to go through all that trouble for me.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, don't worry about it. It was fun!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: In an entirely `freaky` way. Is it me, or did that cabin get `way` creepier since we were last there?
nodes.text_bbcode: In an entirely [color=#e23b3b][i]freaky[/i][/color] way. Is it me, or did that cabin get [color=#e23b3b][i]way[/i][/color] creepier since we were last there?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sounds like someone's afraid of a little old cabin...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey, you didn't see what I saw.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What did you see?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: He thinks he saw a ghost.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Not a `ghost!` An evil spirit come from the other side to hunt us down!
nodes.text_bbcode: Not a [color=#e23b3b][i]ghost![/i][/color] An evil spirit come from the other side to hunt us down!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You really need to stop watching horror movies at night.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You saw it too. You're just too wussy to admit it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Come closer, and say that to my face!
At that moment, Taylor and Paige come up to Zoe's haunted house.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Not bad, not bad.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So the outside looks fine. But I can only imagine what's on the inside.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Let me guess... Sugary sweet cupcakes that say 'Boo' on them?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Actually, yeah. Those are in the party graveyard I put in at the end of my haunted house.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: By the way, `you` don't get one.
nodes.text_bbcode: By the way, [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] don't get one.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ha ha! Just don't forget who made this entire dance a `financial` possibility...
nodes.text_bbcode: Ha ha! Just don't forget who made this entire dance a [color=#3b78e2][i]financial[/i][/color] possibility...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: As long as we don't forget that my side has the city's most scary `gargoyle.`
nodes.text_bbcode: As long as we don't forget that my side has the city's most scary [color=#3b78e2][i]gargoyle.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: All right, you two... You both did a really good job. But I'm not the one you're supposed to be selling all of this to.
Taylor waves her hand at the crowd of students waiting in line for each candidate's attraction.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: If you want to be Social Chair...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Go out there and get votes!
You have reached the end of `The Halloween Dance, Part 1.`
nodes.text_bbcode: You have reached the end of [b]The Halloween Dance, Part 1.[/b]

args.text: Surviving High School
Thanks for playing!

nodes.text: Ben shakes off his panic and rallies his friends.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Come on! We're almost to the door! Get a move on!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: One, two, one, two!
Sam and Spencer listen to Ben, and the three of them rush straight to the open door...
And make it outside!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: There we are!
All at once, Ben feels he can breathe again, and he musters enough strength to quickly pack the gargoyle in the back of Spencer's truck and jump in.
As they drive off, Ben looks back at the cabin in the woods in time to see the door they'd left open swing shut... As though some unseen force had closed it!
Ben panics and drops the gargoyle!
The gargoyle drops onto his foot with a loud crash!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Owwwwww!
Sam and Spencer scramble to get the gargoyle off Ben's foot.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's too heavy without your help, Ben. Can you push while we pull?
They try again, but Ben's awkward angle keeps him from pushing the gargoyle off.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's not working.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What about slipping your foot out?
Ben uselessly tugs at his foot.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No, I can't move it at all...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Okay, I know what to do.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You do?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Sam and I are going to go back to the city to get some help. We'll be right back!
Spencer and Sam leap up and head for the exit!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wait! You're not supposed to leave anyone behind!
But they keep running, oblivious to Ben's call. Ben stares at his trapped foot, trying to calm down.
All around him, the cabin seems to close in, and Ben finds it harder and harder to breathe.
Ben suddenly hears a low but insistent growl echo throughout the house.
When Ben looks up at the gargoyle, its ruby eyes shine, illuminating the room with red light the color of blood...
When Sam and Spencer come back twenty minutes later, there's no trace left of Ben... Or the gargoyle.
Well, one thing's for certain...
Ben has failed.
That didn't end well at all! Try again and see if you can keep Ben calm this time!

nodes.text: Ben readjusts his grip on the statue, and they continue forward a few more paces.
From somewhere behind them, they hear the creaking of wood like footsteps along the hallway.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Did you hear that? `Did you hear that?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Did you hear that? [color=#e23b3b][i]Did you hear that?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I heard it! I heard it!
Sam and Spencer's fear makes them slow down. The footsteps continue until Ben swears they are directly behind him...
They make it a few more feet towards the doorway when the mist from the open windows curls through.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We're slowing down, guys!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It's hard to move, Samface! I have a `bad` feeling about this place! Do you `see` that mist?!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's hard to move, Samface! I have a [color=#e23b3b][i]bad[/i][/color] feeling about this place! Do you [color=#e23b3b][i]see[/i][/color] that mist?!

nodes.text: To Ben's eyes, it makes the room seem almost `ghostly.` His hands shake as he sees figures swirl in the haze.
nodes.text_bbcode: To Ben's eyes, it makes the room seem almost [b]ghostly.[/b] His hands shake as he sees figures swirl in the haze.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just don't want you to throw away what you've worked so hard for.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I know you don't... And that's why I love you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Let me ask you something...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How do `you` feel about transferring back here?
nodes.text_bbcode: How do [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] feel about transferring back here?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Because that's what's really important.
Howard is silent for a moment as if weighing his options.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Part of me is sad about leaving Kingston. In the last couple months, I really did enjoy my time there.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But another part of me wants us to work.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And if I want to honor that... I need to stay.
He sighs.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, I have a little more time. Maybe I'll wait until after the Halloween Dance to decide.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That sounds good.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's awful that you can't go to the dance. I asked Taylor about it, but she says the principal won't budge.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's okay, $ZOE. Thanks for asking.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll take pictures, but I really wanted you to see the haunted house I made with Sam and Ben. It's my best work.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: From what you said, it sounds great.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I hope everyone else will think so too.
You are now playing as Ben.
Meanwhile...
Ben, Sam, and Spencer meet at the house in the woods.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Man, everyone's going to flip when they see this gargoyle!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Do we, uh, do we have to go into the house to get it?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How do you think we're getting it out? Come on. This way...
Sam leads them into the backyard where the gargoyle statue sits.
Spencer and Ben try to lift it, but the gargoyle only moves a foot before they put it down.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No way... It's too heavy for us...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Let me help.
The three of them brace the gargoyle, and together, they can lift the gargoyle enough to move.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Where to?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: There's no exit in the back. We need to go through the house if we're going to get this into the car.
Inside, they slowly but surely move the gargoyle through the house.
They get a room's length away from the front door when they hear a loud 'thud' coming from somewhere behind them.
`Thud.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Thud.[/b]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What... What was that?
`Thud.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Thud.[/b]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't know... But it sounded like a big footstep!
`Thud.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Thud.[/b]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Spencer, quit it!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It's not me, man! I swear!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's coming closer! Let's move!
They move quickly across the room, and Ben feels his hands start to quiver. He fumbles with his grip on the statue.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: If I don't calm down and focus, I'm going to drop the gargoyle...
The house seems to shake around them, and Ben feels the hairs on his neck stand up.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Why?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You spent so much time trying to get into Kingston in the first place.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't want to stand in your way if that's the school that'll make you the most happy.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE, `you` make me happy.
nodes.text_bbcode: $ZOE, [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] make me happy.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And I'm doing this for us.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: At the end of the day, what else matters?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Really? You would?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm so... Relieved.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You are?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This is so important to me... I'm glad that you support it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Of course I do.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But even if I'm completely happy about you being here...

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Howard, this is a big decision. It's not something you can easily undo if you decide you want to go back later.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I know. And I'm thinking about it.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: I'm sure you'll make the right decision.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: But right now... It's time for dessert. We'll talk later, okay?
And for the rest of dinner, they eat ice cream and talk about life at home and the antics of Howard's younger sisters.
$ZOE listens, but she can feel her stomach churn.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That felt like a complete mess...
After dinner, Howard and $ZOE take a walk around the neighborhood.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sorry things at the dinner table got a little crazy.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're telling me.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Look, I'm sorry about what I said to my parents. About why I came back to Centerscore.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, it's technically true. I was the reason you came back.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, but not because `you` were the one who needed `me.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, but not because [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] were the one who needed [color=#e23b3b][i]me.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe I did.
$ZOE leans up and kisses Howard. When they pull apart, he takes her hand.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I need to make a decision soon about transferring if I'm going to enroll in time for winter quarter.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But before I do...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: How do you feel about me being at Centerscore U?
$ZOE bites her lip, hesitating.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's not really my decision, Howard. You're the one who'd be uprooting again to move back.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But you're a big part of why I'd move here. I want to know if this is what you want.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What should I say? I'd feel bad if he moved here just for me, but it would be nice to have him closer.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, if you moved to Centerscore, I'd feel...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard's been really unhappy over at Kingston.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Kingston may have the best classes and programs, but if Howard doesn't do well, then those things don't matter.
Howard's dad doesn't respond, but he looks thoughtful.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think that's a good sign...

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: That's impossible. Kingston is one of the best schools in the `country.`
nodes.text_bbcode: That's impossible. Kingston is one of the best schools in the [color=#e23b3b][i]country.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: In what way is Centerscore University a better school?
$ZOE gulps.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Dad, I think what she means is that it's a better school for `me.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Dad, I think what she means is that it's a better school for [color=#e23b3b][i]me.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Kingston is a great school, but... What if I'm not happy there?
Howard's dad pauses to consider that statement.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Because it's not like Kingston's giving you a lot of money so you can be `here!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Because it's not like Kingston's giving you a lot of money so you can be [color=#e23b3b][i]here![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Horace, we don't discuss `money` at the dinner table.
nodes.text_bbcode: Horace, we don't discuss [color=#3b78e2][i]money[/i][/color] at the dinner table.

nodes.text: The table lapses awkwardly into the subdued sounds of clinking forks and focused chewing.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So that's why Howard told them he'd come back for me.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Hey, can Kel and I be excused? We have homework.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You two are actually going to do your homework?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Yeah! What else would we be doing?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, I don't know... Plotting whatever prank you've got schemed up for Halloween?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Plotting is something we do at `home.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Plotting is something we do at [color=#3b78e2][i]home.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: And it is `work.`
nodes.text_bbcode: And it is [color=#3b78e2][i]work.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Both of you are excused, but I'm checking on you in ten minutes. If I find out you're not doing `actual` homework, neither of you gets dessert tonight.
nodes.text_bbcode: Both of you are excused, but I'm checking on you in ten minutes. If I find out you're not doing [color=#3b78e2][i]actual[/i][/color] homework, neither of you gets dessert tonight.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Aw, mom...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Now go upstairs and take your sister with you.
The girls leave the table. Horace turns to Howard and $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: So we won't discuss how close you might be to losing your scholarship, but what about your future?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: `Horace.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Horace.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: I have a right to know. Howard, what's your plan?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: My plan?

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: You can't live at home forever. So when are you going back to Kingston?
Howard meets $ZOE's eyes, takes a deep breath, and starts talking.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Actually, Dad... I was thinking of transferring to Centerscore U.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: What? Why would you do that?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh...
Howard is at a loss for words. For a flash of a second, he looks to $ZOE for help.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, sir, Centerscore University is...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I mean, I was sad at the beginning...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But over time, I began to feel a lot better.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Of course I `missed` Howard, but I've been holding out. Really, I'm great.
nodes.text_bbcode: Of course I [color=#3b78e2][i]missed[/i][/color] Howard, but I've been holding out. Really, I'm great.

nodes.text: $ZOE glances at Howard who has a pained look on his face.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: If that's the case...
Horace turns his steely gaze on his son.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: What are `you` doing back home?
nodes.text_bbcode: What are [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] doing back home?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We were just so happy together in high school. It's hard to let go.
$ZOE catches Howard's sigh of relief.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Looks like I said the right thing...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Howard said you took things hard. We were curious about how much of a toll this had taken on you.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Maybe you were. `I` was mainly wondering why Howard came back...
nodes.text_bbcode: Maybe you were. [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] was mainly wondering why Howard came back...

nodes.text: $ZOE knocks on the door to Howard's house. She smiles when Howard answers.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hi, Howard! I'm really excited to see your parents again.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, listen... I need to warn you about something...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: My parents were asking why I was in town, and I kind of told them--
Howard gets cut off when his father suddenly appears at the door beside him.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: $ZOE, you're here! Come and sit down. Dinner's on the table!
As Howard's dad herds $ZOE into the kitchen, she throws Howard a questioning look. He shrugs.
At the dinner table...
$ZOE sits down with Howard's parents and his sisters.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: It's nice to see you again, $ZOE. We enjoy having you around.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks for inviting me over. I really missed you all.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Of course you did. And don't you ever think there's anything wrong with that.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh, no... There isn't.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We missed you too, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Did you bring us cupcakes?

nodes.speaker: Baby Kara
nodes.text: Cup cook? Cup cook?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry, girls... I didn't.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Did you stop baking because you were sad?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sad?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Girls, you don't ask guests questions like that!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: But Howard said he came back because $ZOE was so sad that he'd left.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard said that?
She shoots Howard a look.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I may have mentioned that at some point...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I didn't like Howard going away, but it had to happen.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: He said you were crying all the time!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Not `all the time.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Not [color=#3b78e2][i]all the time.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: $ZOE, it's all right. You don't have to talk about it.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Howard told us just how devastated you were. We're very concerned about you.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: How are you holding up, dear?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know why Howard told his parents all of that... But what should I say?

options.label: I feel better now that Howard's back.

nodes.text: $ZOE herds Sam into the mad scientist's laboratory...
$ZOE pulls Sam down a pitch black hallway.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're going to have to do a lot better than a dark hallway to get me--

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, welcome to the dance room!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: The what now?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I thought it'd be cool to make a dance floor out of a graveyard. I'll be blasting music out here. It'll be fun!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Cool.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So what do you think of the house?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I didn't think you had it in you, but this is awesome!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, Ben brought all the cool props in. I couldn't have done it without his help.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You did come up with a lot of the ideas.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It was a team effort.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I've seen better...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What? It's not `bad!`
nodes.text_bbcode: What? It's not [color=#3b78e2][i]bad![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It doesn't affect me, but I'm sure it'll scare the pants off everyone else!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's good enough, I guess.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: There's only one thing I'd add that would take it from that-was-kind-of-scary frightening to keep-me-up-at-night frightening.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And what's that?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: A gargoyle. And not just `any` gargoyle... The one from the old cabin in the woods!
nodes.text_bbcode: A gargoyle. And not just [color=#e23b3b][i]any[/i][/color] gargoyle... The one from the old cabin in the woods!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah! That thing freaked everyone out last night. We `have` to get it!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah! That thing freaked everyone out last night. We [color=#3b78e2][i]have[/i][/color] to get it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It would be awesome, but I wouldn't be able to do it. I have that dinner thing with Howard's family that I can't miss.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And they're locking the gym up until the dance, so we couldn't do it tomorrow afternoon either.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry, guys...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But the haunted house looks great! Thanks for all your help, Ben. I'll see you at the dance tomorrow!
As $ZOE leaves, Ben turns to Sam.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, `$ZOE` can't steal the statue...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, [color=#e23b3b][i]$ZOE[/i][/color] can't steal the statue...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But that doesn't mean `we` can't...
nodes.text_bbcode: But that doesn't mean [color=#e23b3b][i]we[/i][/color] can't...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm in.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Call Spencer. We're going to need his truck.
Ben has failed.
Try again and see if you can help Ben get out of the house in time!

nodes.text: It's too heavy without your help, Ben. Can you push while we pull?

nodes.text: It's not working.

nodes.text: What about slipping your foot out?

nodes.text: You do?

$ZOE and Sam stand in front of the haunted house, waiting for people to show up.
So I didn't really get to talk to you until now. How was dinner with Howard's family?
His parents aren't happy that he wants to stay in Centerscore.
I'm not surprised.
Me neither.
Does this mean he'll go back to Kingston?
He's not sure yet. And I don't know if I want him to stay or go.
That sucks.
When we dated before... It was so easy. But now, it's never felt so hard for us to be together.
And I don't know what to do about that.
At that moment, Spencer comes up to them.
Hey... You two look bummed out. Want to dance?
What kind of pick-up line is that?
Not a pick-up line at all! It's just early, and I want to tear up the dance floor.
Is that so wrong?
I guess not. $ZOE, you coming?
I should stay here.
Sam and Spencer join their other friends on the dance floor between $ZOE and Paige's attractions.
$ZOE looks out over the crowd, wishing...
And that's when she feels a hand on her shoulder.
I hope it's not Nate...
She turns to find Howard standing behind her, holding a mask in his hand.
Howard!
Howard embraces her.
But how are you here?
It could be because I battled my way past security, burst through the doors, and snuck past the teachers...
Or maybe it's just because of this.
Howard holds up a badge with the words 'Parent Chaperone' on the front.
You're kidding.
Nope. Anyone can volunteer to chaperone the dance.
Which means you and I can enjoy the dance...
Together.
And that's your bonus scene!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: The music is an awesome touch. I can feel chills up my spine!
The strobe light flashes on and off, emphasizing worms in jars, eyeballs in tanks, and green liquid moving between beakers.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ewwww... This is gross!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Gross good or gross bad?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Gross good!
Suddenly, a light flashes, and Sam sees a clown swooping down on her!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ahhhh! A clown!
She runs to the end of the hall and exits out into the cemetery at the back.

nodes.title: The Halloween Dance, Part 1
nodes.subtitle: Can $ZOE beat Paige in this Social Chair showdown?

nodes.text: You are now playing as Ben.
It's the night before Halloween, and Ben, Emily, and their friends are in an abandoned house in the woods...
They sit in a semi-circle around a fireplace, the dim light from a low fire flickering across them.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So what are we doing here?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: It's kind of creepy...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's that point, Em! It's the night before Halloween! And you know what that means...
He pauses dramatically, but everyone stares at him blankly.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: If Spencer were here, he'd know what I'm talking about. Where is he, anyway?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Come on, Ben! What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm talking about scary ghost stories!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Ooh! I have one! It's about `imaginary numbers.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Ooh! I have one! It's about [color=#3b78e2][i]imaginary numbers.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: The only one who thinks those are spooky is you, Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But they could be anywhere!
Ben lights a flashlight and holds it up to his face.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I have a story... And it's one that took place in this very house!
Everyone quiets down as Ben weaves his tale.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: This house wasn't always empty. A long time ago, a sculptor lived here with his wife and child.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: This sculptor was very gifted. But the subjects of his work were always dark. He was obsessed with sculpting creatures of the `night.`
nodes.text_bbcode: This sculptor was very gifted. But the subjects of his work were always dark. He was obsessed with sculpting creatures of the [color=#e23b3b][i]night.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: The fire crackles, and everyone sitting close to it jumps a little.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: One night, on a night just like this, he sculpted a gargoyle statue with bat wings and ruby eyes so real that it seemed it had flown right out of the underworld.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It terrified his wife, and she begged him to destroy the gargoyle, but when he tried, something strange happened... The gargoyle came alive right before his eyes!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh no! Why'd it do that?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Because...

pov_note: Multi-POV episode. `pov` on a segment is the playable character in control on entry; a node's `set_pov` switches the current POV mid-stream (these are the game's 'You are now playing as X' cards). A dialogue node's `side` is 'left' when the speaker is the current POV (the game shows the current main on the left) and 'right' otherwise. POV is propagated in execution order from `entry`; only main_characters can hold it.
